shortDescription: Add or remove a static route

options.name: destination
options.description: Destination IP address in CIDR format (ip address/prefix length).

options.name: gateway
options.description: The gateway used by the static route. If C(gateway) is not provided it will be set to C(0.0.0.0).

options.name: metric
options.description: Metric used by the static route.

options.name: state
options.description: If C(absent), it removes a network static route. If C(present), it adds a network static route.
